# Synthetic converter samples

These files contain authored prompts, paths, messages and tool work.
They contain no captured private sessions or credentials.

Cursor uses the 2026.06.24 transcript layout.
Mux mirrors the v0.27.0 source contract.
Mistral Vibe uses the legacy v1 transcript contract.
Their oracle prompts and tool work are synthetic.
Gemini CLI uses the native worked example in `agents/gemini-cli.md`.
Its recording has no application version field.
The fx example is an authored `event_log_v1` committed store.
Temporary tests also build unified Vibe generations and fx replacement chunks.

The corresponding ASR files are in `tests/golden-w1-conv-a`.
See [the adapter notes](../../../ADAPTERS-W1A.md) for supported mappings and limits.
